registry_candidates.name: existing_entries_cited_by_adr_0019
registry_candidates.entry_yaml: Append docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md to referenced_by of these existing entries: interfaces command_submission, zoom_request, render_layout, presentation_facet, presentation_stage_order; api_decisions frame_order, lint_forbidden_token_list, source_layout; forbidden_patterns presentation_submit_without_handle, cosmetic_phase_from_tick_counter (the avatar tick-stepped frames exception, see foundation_asks), command_constructed_outside_kernel; interfaces owner_callable_contract and mutator_status (the four Controller mutators are Class A).

gdd_sync.new: through four published status-returning mutators (Class A in ADR-0003's taxonomy: each has a `check_*` twin and returns OK, REFUSED or -fault_code; ADR-0019 § 2.5)

gdd_sync.old: **→ ADR** (InputMap vs a custom binding layer; edge detection by event vs polling).
gdd_sync.new: **Decided in ADR-0019 § 3.2 and § 3.3**: `InputMap` actions registered at runtime from data with the any-device wildcard and `physical_keycode`; ordered edges latched in `_input` and continuous state polled in `_process`; devices identified by event type.

gdd_sync.old: the engine's echo flag is **[UNV]** until the ADR spike
gdd_sync.new: probed 2026-10-29 on 4.7.2: a synthetic echo event does not re-fire `is_action_just_pressed`; real OS key repeat is still **[UNV]** until PC-INPUT-SPIKE-1 (d)

gdd_sync.old: THEN** the Suit read it requests is `locomotion_cap` only and never Suit's internal vitals ladder.
gdd_sync.new: THEN** the Suit reads it requests are `locomotion_cap` and `stowed_heavy` only (TR-suit-033) and never Suit's internal vitals ladder.

gdd_sync.old: Derived (idle breathing, tick-stepped) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*: `frame_idle = posmod(floor((T − T_enter) / IDLE_FRAME_TICKS), 6)`
gdd_sync.new: Derived (idle breathing, tick-stepped) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review; free-running from the committed tick, ADR-0019 § 7.1)*: `frame_idle = posmod(floor(T / IDLE_FRAME_TICKS), 6)`

gdd_sync.old: Either the Adapter hands the cursor position and zoom edges to the pipeline root, or the lint carries an allow-list naming the pipeline root.
gdd_sync.new: Resolved by ADR-0019 § 6.4 and § 8.1: the Adapter owns every Input read, the pipeline root reads none, zoom edges reach it by `request_zoom_step` and the cursor is published as `AdapterViews.cursor_px()`; the lint carries an allow-list of the Adapter's registered files. (Earlier text:) Either the Adapter hands the cursor position and zoom edges to the pipeline root, or the lint carries an allow-list naming the pipeline root.

foundation_asks.ask: Publish a read-only accessor for the follow pose f_q on PipelineRoot next to layout, layout_version and present_time (for example `var follow_pose_q: Vector2i`, same type as mouse_to_world_aim's f_q parameter). ADR-0019 § 3.1 and § 6.1 read it, and ADR-0008's Key Interfaces expose none. State that it holds the previous frame's CAMERA_SOLVE value when read from the INPUT_ADAPTER priority.

Record a named, narrow exception to registry pattern cosmetic_phase_from_tick_counter: AvatarFrames (src/presentation/controller/avatar/avatar_frames.gd) may derive the avatar's tick-stepped frames (idle breathing free-running, work/stagger/down anchored on sim-held entry ticks) from the committed tick, because TR-pc-038 and TR-pc-039 require byte-identical per-tick Presenter samples across 30/60/120/144 fps; these freeze under PAUSED because T does not advance. The pattern has no lint (ADR-0010 6.6b), so the exception is enforced by review and the avatar cadence test.

(a) Mirror the cosmetic-phase exception above in the presenter rules: only AvatarFrames may read frame.T for phase, and the presenter tests assert no other presenter does. (b) In section 3's reads check, state that the published views of an INPUT_SURFACE object (AdapterViews) are products of the input phase and count as earlier than every stage, so the Avatar Presenter, HUD, Instruments, Audio and the Chart Table layer may read them without a stage id.

Add to the 6.6 rule inventory: the controller pack tools/lint/controller_lint.gd with rules CTL-01 to CTL-09, CTL-11 and CTL-12 (CTL-10 is deliberately unassigned); the READ-01 allow-list file tools/lint/config/allowlists/input_surface.json listing src/presentation/controller/input/{input_adapter,engine_input_source,binding_factory,raw_event,dev_actions}.gd for the symbol set Input, InputMap, InputEvent*, _input, _unhandled_input, _unhandled_key_input, _shortcut_input; the CTL-02 token rule that .device is never compared with an integer literal or DEVICE_ID_* anywhere in src/ and tools/; and an edges.json entry allowing presentation/controller to name only src/sim/controller/views. Also note the AVATAR-* content-lint family (sheet and sidecar checks, TR-pc-046) for tools/ci/content_lint.gd under ADR-0007 2.2.

Confirm (documentation only) that a status-returning mutator with a check_ twin and no out parameter, such as the Controller's four, is Class A, and that architecture.md's Mutator contract block may list it without an out object when the mutator produces no data.

decisions.point: Split into Adapter / Sim / Presenter and directory placement
decisions.chosen: Adapter (INPUT_SURFACE) and Avatar Presenter (PRESENTATION) in src/presentation/controller, Controller Sim in src/sim/controller; disjoint rights enforced by facet type, import matrix and lint CTL-01
decisions.reason: Presentation never writes a block, the sim has no Node, a MIRROR peer must draw a remote body from state; ADR-0010 already lists the occupants

decisions.chosen: Ratified: Ship Body owns pos/sub/odometer and LocomotionStep; Controller owns intent, gait, aim, facing, loco_state, carry, channel; Controller never writes body.state
decisions.reason: Composite ship and body transfers are Body's; deterministic step needs no physics observations; avoids Layout projection inside an input system

decisions.chosen: controller.step clears only channel_ref, channel_face and channel_body; the pos_prev == pos_curr and sub reset is written by Body's transfer mutators (ADR-0015)
decisions.reason: The registered text assigns Body fields to the Controller, contradicting PC-14, GDD 'the Controller does not write sub' and TR-shipbody-048

decisions.point: Class of the four channel/carry mutators
decisions.chosen: Class A (status return, check_ twin, scope.fault on defect), not the GDD's 'Class B'
decisions.reason: ADR-0003 distinguishes Class B by void return and clamping; the GDD requires a status and face_octant rejection

decisions.point: Edge detection by event vs polling
decisions.chosen: Ordered press/release records latched in _input into a preallocated EdgeRing, continuous state polled with get_action_raw_strength in _process; submit only from _process
decisions.reason: Probe: a same-frame press and release leaves just_pressed and just_released both true and pressed false, so polling cannot order them; latch-until-released and hold-cancel need order

decisions.chosen: _input, with set_input_as_handled for events turned into MenuInput in chart_table and boot contexts
decisions.reason: A focused Control would consume a press before _unhandled_input and the Adapter would silently miss an ACCEPT

decisions.chosen: InputMap actions registered at runtime from data tables (actions, context matrix, default bindings, keycap tokens) with zero engine deadzone; user overrides host-local in SettingsStore
decisions.reason: Engine matching and per-device merging are reused; deadzones are the Adapter's only; actions are ledgered ints for stable rebind files

decisions.chosen: Classify by event type; never compare InputEvent.device to a literal or DEVICE_ID_*; every code-built binding sets device -1 (BINDING_ANY_DEVICE); physical_keycode for keys
decisions.reason: Probe: bindings keep their constructor device (pad default 0 matches only pad 0); 4.7 changed keyboard/mouse ids to 16/32

decisions.chosen: All device reads behind an @abstract InputSource returning ints in ANALOG_UNITS and Vector2i; only five files hold Input tokens
decisions.reason: Unit tests and trace replay with a scripted source; READ-01 allow-list stays tiny

decisions.chosen: Change-based set_move_intent and set_aim (LATEST_PER_ACTOR_PER_TICK), intents before commands in a frame, set_aim on the D.7 predicate counted in committed ticks; every submit carries a non-zero correlation including intents
decisions.reason: Bounded traffic inside the 26 commands/s budget; the result record has no type field, so correlation attributes a rejection to an intent kind

decisions.chosen: Intents are accepted and stored in every state except DEAD (including STAGGERED, DOWNED, IN_POD); the locks live in controller.step
decisions.reason: The held direction must already be in the row when a stagger or pod stay ends so there is no intermediate IDLE tick

decisions.chosen: stagger is SYSTEM-origin with the target in payload {actor}; give_up is PLAYER with the actor argument and an empty payload; give_up solo test is a controller.state row count of one
decisions.reason: submit_system has no actor parameter; solo detection needs no kernel session fact at MVP

decisions.chosen: One mechanism (last_acked := UNKNOWN, rate-limited to one resend per AIM_SEND_INTERVAL) with five labelled triggers; PAUSED->RUNNING and LOADING->RUNNING share one 'first RUNNING frame after non-RUNNING' path; Adapter silent while not RUNNING
decisions.reason: The frame entering RUNNING runs no tick and the Adapter runs at -100, so its resync lands in P2 of the first post-restore tick (TR-shipbody-050)

decisions.chosen: Dictionary with String keys, one PackedInt64Array column per persisted field named by ControllerSchema.fields(), rows sorted by player_id; chest_sim and hand_sim derived and never persisted
decisions.reason: Self-describing dump-save, canonical-friendly, field-agreement test is a key-set comparison, no Vector2i

decisions.chosen: ControllerSchema.fields() drives the typed row, the view getters and the payload columns; a unit test fails if any disagree
decisions.reason: The GDD's three lists had drifted before

decisions.chosen: [body.state, suit.state]
decisions.reason: post_restore reads both; the kernel GDD orders restore by this DAG and runs every post_restore after every restore; declares the dependency under either reading ADR-0016 settles

decisions.chosen: PLAYER 1 (P/<player_id>, published fields) and BOOK 2 (B/<player_id>, persisted fields no presenter reads); no events; quiet_writes_allowed false
decisions.reason: ADR-0004 leaves Controller kind numbers to this ADR; equal writes mark nothing so a standing avatar is silent

decisions.chosen: PC_NO_SUCH_ROW, PC_FACE_OCTANT_RANGE, PC_CHANNEL_OWNER_UNKNOWN, PC_CARRY_REF_INVALID, PC_RESTORE_SHAPE, PC_RESTORE_RANGE, PC_RESTORE_VERSION, PC_STEP_BAD_ENUM, PC_ROW_DUPLICATE
decisions.reason: ADR-0003 fixes domain 7 and leaves local codes to the owner; PC_ prefix follows the GDD's frozen diagnostics names

decisions.chosen: Adapter-local InputContextMachine; context x action matrix is data, return table is code with one test per row; forced return to GAMEPLAY polled from loco_state; Adapter holds no ControlHandle and the Chart Table layer's PauseGate issues request_pause
decisions.reason: Contexts are presentation; the sim sees only the zero intent and cancel submitted on entry; pause rights are named handles (ADR-0002)

decisions.chosen: Only RenderLayout.mouse_to_world_aim(cursor_px, f_q) with its single picture-origin subtraction; aim_q = posmod(roundi(theta*AIM_UNITS/TAU), AIM_UNITS); mouse_to_world_view banned in the aim path (CTL-06)
decisions.reason: Open loop avoids the look-ahead feedback; exactly one letterbox subtraction exists; round-then-posmod per D.7

decisions.chosen: Accept that the Adapter (-100) reads the previous frame's f_q and layout with the last committed pos_curr, and on a zoom edge uses the stored cursor_off for one warp frame
decisions.reason: Coherent one-frame-old snapshot inside the GDD's recorded trade-off; warp read-back is a spike item

decisions.point: How the pipeline root 'receives' the cursor (TR-pc-032)
decisions.chosen: The root reads no Input; zoom edges arrive by request_zoom_step and the cursor is published as AdapterViews.cursor_px()
decisions.reason: Needs no new PipelineRoot interface and keeps the Input fence to the Adapter's files

decisions.point: Pulled views vs signals for Adapter outputs
decisions.chosen: AdapterViews is pulled with monotonic sequence counters (context, device, inspect_ref); the inspect_card_context_signal is realised as a pulled view
decisions.reason: A once-per-frame consumer cannot miss an edge; matches ADR-0009 and Interaction view patterns

decisions.chosen: Correlation-keyed PrePlayLedger ring; body and sound only, never effect or beam light; withdraw on immediate-reason rejection via Interaction's ReasonClass; Presenter and Audio read tokens through AdapterViews
decisions.reason: ADR-0009 section 7 assigns pre-play to this ADR; light and effects change only on committed state

decisions.chosen: Confirm and tap timers use the Adapter's _process delta clamped to CONFIRM_DT_MAX_S and freeze whenever the kernel is not RUNNING; the device-switch interval and name reveal read the injected monotonic Clock and are not frozen
decisions.reason: A destructive hold must not complete during a pause, but glyphs must follow a device switch while the Chart Table is open under PAUSED

decisions.point: Idle and other tick-stepped avatar frames vs the cosmetic-phase pattern
decisions.chosen: Idle breathing free-running from committed T; work, stagger and down anchored on sim-held entry ticks (channel start tick from Interaction, stagger_end_tick - STAGGER_TICKS, t_downed); recorded as a narrow exception to cosmetic_phase_from_tick_counter and filed as a foundation ask
decisions.reason: TR-pc-038/039 need byte-identical per-tick samples across cadences, which present_time cannot give; anchored loops keep weld animations starting at frame 0

decisions.chosen: Audio reads published odometer, gait, octant, facing; the Presenter's anim_counter is private; AvatarFrames.moving_frame is a shared pure function; FOOT_CONTACT_FRAMES comes from the sidecar
decisions.reason: Presentation-to-presentation edges are allowed and a private counter cannot be mistaken for a sim fact

decisions.chosen: 'Import fails' read as the asset-pipeline CI gate: numeric CHEST/HAND bounds as domain-2 named structural invariants of the sidecar table, lamp-plate occlusion as an AVATAR-* content-lint family; no runtime clamp in the Presenter (CTL-11)
decisions.reason: Avoids an editor-only importer plugin; one loader fails the game, tests and offline lint

decisions.chosen: tools/lint/config/allowlists/input_surface.json naming five Adapter files; controller_lint.gd rules CTL-01..09, 11, 12; CTL-10 unassigned (no-buffering is a behavioural test)
decisions.reason: ADR-0010 READ-01 leaves the list to ADR-0019; only five files hold engine input tokens

decisions.chosen: Integer-only per-frame text records (delta_us, analog milli-units, ordered edges, wheel net, cursor, pipeline values, kernel state/load_seq, focus/pad flags); cadence test uses at_tick events at multiples of 10 ticks; the simulation replays the recorded submission log, not a re-run Adapter
decisions.reason: All inputs are ints so the same build replays exactly; atan2 is not claimed bit-identical across machines; 10 is the LCM of the four frame periods in ticks

decisions.chosen: tool_cycle cycles from the Adapter's pending_tool over held slots 1-3 (one equip_tool per press); the console seam asks the Chart Table's pure resolver for SUBMIT/OPEN_CHART/NONE and injects ChartPick through a two-row table
decisions.reason: Two presses in one frame before commit must advance twice; CT-10 rows stay in the Chart Table, not the Adapter

decisions.chosen: controller.state rows are keyed by PlayerId and store no actor id; the Controller and Adapter resolve actor<->seat through Body's published seat_of_actor / actor_of_seat
decisions.reason: The seat is stored once (Body's seat) and the binding rebuild source stays Body's and Emitter's

cross_adr_assumptions.assumption: Body publishes body_of_actor(actor), actor_of_seat(player_id), seat_of_actor(actor), a pod-body test, home_body, moved(actor) and pos_curr/pos_prev/sub/odometer views; its transfer mutators (BM3 weld, BM4 detach, BM5 pod hop) reset pos_prev == pos_curr and sub in P2 so the Controller writes nothing in body.state; body.integrate is `after: [controller.step, layout.doors]` and reads the Controller's octant, gait_effective and intent_octant; PC-14 is adopted verbatim.

restore_after orders restore calls and every post_restore runs after every restore; controller.state declares restore_after [body.state, suit.state], and neither body.state nor suit.state declares restore_after on controller.state (no cycle); Suit's post_restore, if it derives locomotion_cap, runs before the Controller's; ADR-0016's carry_ref verifier checks that carry_ref resolves in Interaction's loose[] (controller.state holds only the bare id).

Interaction publishes a candidate query (caller-owned buffer of ref, distance, anchor, lit flag, declared verb and mode) that the Adapter scores per D.9 and a pulled focus/prompt view that echoes the Adapter's focus_ref and self_target; it declares the verb command type for the focused object, the pure ReasonClass.is_immediate(reason) table, cancel_channel and begin_* validates that read intent_octant; the channel record publishes its start tick for the work-loop animation anchor; validates reject for loco_state DEAD, DOWNED, IN_POD and STAGGERED per their rules; the three-part channel_view seqs (TR-hud-036) are Interaction's.

Suit publishes locomotion_cap(player_id), stowed_heavy(player_id), tool_in_hand(player_id) and the held tool slots 1-3; equip_tool {slot} is its command; the Controller reads only locomotion_cap and stowed_heavy.

The Chart Table layer consumes MenuInputQueue (drained once per frame after the Adapter), publishes cursor_hint through AdapterViews.set_cursor_hint, owns PauseGate and the opening of the layer on a chart_table context change, supplies ChartPickSource.resolve(prompt_verb), builds no Control that takes GUI navigation or keyboard focus (or supplies a text-entry probe), keeps its menu hold fills on engine time, owns SettingsStore for binding overrides and InputSettings, sets HUD nodes mouse_filter IGNORE / focus_mode NONE in gameplay, and keeps the Adapter PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS under any SceneTree.paused scheme.

Audio drives footfalls from Body's odometer and the Controller's gait_effective, octant and facing via the shared AvatarFrames.moving_frame, never from the Presenter's anim_counter; FOOT_CONTACT_FRAMES comes from the character sidecar; restore priming and the one-footfall catch-up poll are Audio's; Audio reads the Adapter's pre-play tokens through AdapterViews.

Attention publishes the push_stimulus Class B mutator that controller.noise calls once per moved tick (and the BURDEN push); Attention and Horror (ADR-0023) read only ControllerView.loco_state (lint CTL-05).
Emitter publishes the seat's beam id (actor for toggle_beam, actor_source emitter.state) and a beam view the Presenter reads (lit, shape); the beam light changes only on committed state.
Web Map owns the forbidden-action name list consumed by lint CTL-09 (HOP_LEG_TICKS is the sole pacing lever) and the pod body semantics behind IN_POD.
Dev feature tags gate dev_actions.gd, the PC_* diagnostics channels and the input-trace recorder so a release export file list contains none of them.

Co-op seats make the give_up solo test a kernel session fact instead of a controller.state row count; MIRROR runs no hook, so facing and channel_face arrive only as replicated state; remote ingress adds no second Adapter.

open_questions: TR-pc-035 as registered in tr-registry.yaml and requirements-traceability.md attributes Body's pos_prev == pos_curr and sub reset to controller.step; ADR-0019 reads it as Body's transfer mutators (ADR-0015) and the Controller clearing only the channel fields. Re-word the registered text at /architecture-review Phase 8; the GDD body never says it, so no GDD edit is proposed.

PC-INPUT-SPIKE-1 (a) to (i) must be run on a windowed 4.7.2 session and a release export: root mouse position units and fractional values under display scaling, warp_mouse read-back and synthetic motion under CONFINED_HIDDEN, wheel burst size per frame, real OS echo flag, which focus notification fires, pad ids / SDL3 merge / joy_connection_changed timing, -1 wildcard on real pads, Adapter-before-driver order on a release export (shared with KRN-LAT-02), and keyboard_get_label_from_physical on AZERTY/QWERTZ.
OQ-A: does the -1 any-device wildcard match every pad on a real SDL3 machine; fallback is per-device bindings rebuilt on joy_connection_changed behind BindingFactory.
OQ-B: does ADR-0030's Chart Table layer build any Control that takes keyboard focus (name entry, slot list)? If so set_input_as_handled in chart_table needs a TextEntryProbe port.
OQ-C: give_up solo detection is a controller.state row count; replace with a kernel session fact when co-op seats exist (ADR-0032).
OQ-D: shape of Interaction's candidate query and the focus/prompt echo view must be fixed in ADR-0020.
OQ-E: avatar sidecar table and lamp-plate mask formats do not exist (/asset-spec pending); ADR-0019 fixes where the checks run and what they report, not the file formats.
OQ-F: should a device switch to PAD also latch on a left-stick crossing the movement deadzone? The GDD says last button or key; ADR-0019 follows it.

The Controller Sim's Suit reads are locomotion_cap and stowed_heavy (TR-suit-033), but TR-pc-025 and AC-PCI-210 say locomotion_cap only; GDD sync proposed for AC-PCI-210, and the TR-pc-025 registered wording needs the same fix at Phase 8.
architecture.md's Required ADRs row for ADR-0019 says 21 requirements; the traceability index lists 42 in the Planned column plus residual halves; the index is authoritative.
TD ratification of PC-14 is the review of this ADR; until the ADR is Accepted the split is Proposed with the rest.

data.summary: ADR-0019 (Proposed, 2026-10-29) fixes the Player Controller split. An INPUT_SURFACE Input Adapter in src/presentation/controller/input is the only reader of Input.*, InputMap and InputEvent. It holds the single SurfaceHandle `input_adapter` and writes no block. A Controller Sim in src/sim/controller owns block controller.state, four commands (set_move_intent, set_aim, give_up, stagger), two hooks and four status-returning mutators. It owns no position: PC-14 is ratified, so Ship Body keeps pos/sub/odometer. A PRESENTATION Avatar Presenter at stage AVATAR only draws. The ADR also decides: a single field list (ControllerSchema.fields()) that drives the block, the read view and the column-per-field snapshot (TR-pc-037); change-based intents with one resync mechanism and five labelled triggers; ordered edge latching in `_input` with continuous state polled in `_process`; data-driven actions and bindings with a -1 any-device wildcard and device identity by event type for Godot 4.7; the context machine, with its matrix as data, and the cursor policy; the Adapter-owned MenuInput ring; the open-loop aim path via RenderLayout.mouse_to_world_aim with round-then-posmod and the zoom/handover cursor warp; the Avatar Presenter write list and sheet-lint gate; the input_surface.json allow-list; lint pack CTL-01..12; the input-trace format and a tick-keyed cadence-invariance test. Probed 2026-10-29 on 4.7.2 headless: DEVICE_ID_MOUSE=32, KEYBOARD=16, EMULATION=-1; code-built bindings match only their constructor device (pad default 0), so they must be set to -1; echo does not re-fire just_pressed; a same-frame press and release cannot be ordered by polling; polling an unregistered action logs an ERROR line. Warp, confinement, wheel burst, pad ids and focus notifications are UNVERIFIED and bound to PC-INPUT-SPIKE-1. Coverage is 35 covered, 7 partial and 20 owned elsewhere (62 rows).

    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed

    not: "polling just_pressed/just_released alone (a same-frame press and release cannot be ordered, probed 2026-10-29); _unhandled_input latching; submit from _input, a signal handler or _physics_process; input buffering (ACTION_BUFFER_TICKS 0)"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    reason: "Ordered edges are needed by latch-until-released, fresh-press and hold-cancel rules; a focused Control would otherwise consume a press before _unhandled_input; one tick of latency"
    referenced_by:

    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    reason: "The simulation's intent must equal the player's hands within one tick of RUNNING at a fraction of the traffic"

Confirm (documentation only) that a status-returning mutator with a check_ twin and no out parameter, such as the Controller's four, is Class A, and that architecture.md's Mutator contract block may list it without an out object when the mutator produces no data.

decisions.point: Split into Adapter / Sim / Presenter and directory placement
decisions.chosen: Adapter (INPUT_SURFACE) and Avatar Presenter (PRESENTATION) in src/presentation/controller, Controller Sim in src/sim/controller; disjoint rights enforced by facet type, import matrix and lint CTL-01
decisions.reason: Presentation never writes a block, the sim has no Node, a MIRROR peer must draw a remote body from state; ADR-0010 already lists the occupants

decisions.chosen: Ratified: Ship Body owns pos/sub/odometer and LocomotionStep; Controller owns intent, gait, aim, facing, loco_state, carry, channel; Controller never writes body.state
decisions.reason: Composite ship and body transfers are Body's; deterministic step needs no physics observations; avoids Layout projection inside an input system

decisions.chosen: controller.step clears only channel_ref, channel_face and channel_body; the pos_prev == pos_curr and sub reset is written by Body's transfer mutators (ADR-0015)
decisions.reason: The registered text assigns Body fields to the Controller, contradicting PC-14, GDD 'the Controller does not write sub' and TR-shipbody-048

decisions.point: Class of the four channel/carry mutators
decisions.chosen: Class A (status return, check_ twin, scope.fault on defect), not the GDD's 'Class B'
decisions.reason: ADR-0003 distinguishes Class B by void return and clamping; the GDD requires a status and face_octant rejection

decisions.point: Edge detection by event vs polling
decisions.chosen: Ordered press/release records latched in _input into a preallocated EdgeRing, continuous state polled with get_action_raw_strength in _process; submit only from _process
decisions.reason: Probe: a same-frame press and release leaves just_pressed and just_released both true and pressed false, so polling cannot order them; latch-until-released and hold-cancel need order

decisions.chosen: _input, with set_input_as_handled for events turned into MenuInput in chart_table and boot contexts
decisions.reason: A focused Control would consume a press before _unhandled_input and the Adapter would silently miss an ACCEPT

decisions.chosen: InputMap actions registered at runtime from data tables (actions, context matrix, default bindings, keycap tokens) with zero engine deadzone; user overrides host-local in SettingsStore
decisions.reason: Engine matching and per-device merging are reused; deadzones are the Adapter's only; actions are ledgered ints for stable rebind files

decisions.chosen: Classify by event type; never compare InputEvent.device to a literal or DEVICE_ID_*; every code-built binding sets device -1 (BINDING_ANY_DEVICE); physical_keycode for keys
decisions.reason: Probe: bindings keep their constructor device (pad default 0 matches only pad 0); 4.7 changed keyboard/mouse ids to 16/32

decisions.chosen: All device reads behind an @abstract InputSource returning ints in ANALOG_UNITS and Vector2i; only five files hold Input tokens
decisions.reason: Unit tests and trace replay with a scripted source; READ-01 allow-list stays tiny

decisions.chosen: Change-based set_move_intent and set_aim (LATEST_PER_ACTOR_PER_TICK), intents before commands in a frame, set_aim on the D.7 predicate counted in committed ticks; every submit carries a non-zero correlation including intents
decisions.reason: Bounded traffic inside the 26 commands/s budget; the result record has no type field, so correlation attributes a rejection to an intent kind

decisions.chosen: Intents are accepted and stored in every state except DEAD (including STAGGERED, DOWNED, IN_POD); the locks live in controller.step
decisions.reason: The held direction must already be in the row when a stagger or pod stay ends so there is no intermediate IDLE tick

decisions.chosen: stagger is SYSTEM-origin with the target in payload {actor}; give_up is PLAYER with the actor argument and an empty payload; give_up solo test is a controller.state row count of one
decisions.reason: submit_system has no actor parameter; solo detection needs no kernel session fact at MVP

decisions.chosen: One mechanism (last_acked := UNKNOWN, rate-limited to one resend per AIM_SEND_INTERVAL) with five labelled triggers; PAUSED->RUNNING and LOADING->RUNNING share one 'first RUNNING frame after non-RUNNING' path; Adapter silent while not RUNNING
decisions.reason: The frame entering RUNNING runs no tick and the Adapter runs at -100, so its resync lands in P2 of the first post-restore tick (TR-shipbody-050)

decisions.chosen: Dictionary with String keys, one PackedInt64Array column per persisted field named by ControllerSchema.fields(), rows sorted by player_id; chest_sim and hand_sim derived and never persisted
decisions.reason: Self-describing dump-save, canonical-friendly, field-agreement test is a key-set comparison, no Vector2i

decisions.chosen: ControllerSchema.fields() drives the typed row, the view getters and the payload columns; a unit test fails if any disagree
decisions.reason: The GDD's three lists had drifted before

decisions.chosen: [body.state, suit.state]
decisions.reason: post_restore reads both; the kernel GDD orders restore by this DAG and runs every post_restore after every restore; declares the dependency under either reading ADR-0016 settles

decisions.chosen: PLAYER 1 (P/<player_id>, published fields) and BOOK 2 (B/<player_id>, persisted fields no presenter reads); no events; quiet_writes_allowed false
decisions.reason: ADR-0004 leaves Controller kind numbers to this ADR; equal writes mark nothing so a standing avatar is silent

decisions.chosen: PC_NO_SUCH_ROW, PC_FACE_OCTANT_RANGE, PC_CHANNEL_OWNER_UNKNOWN, PC_CARRY_REF_INVALID, PC_RESTORE_SHAPE, PC_RESTORE_RANGE, PC_RESTORE_VERSION, PC_STEP_BAD_ENUM, PC_ROW_DUPLICATE
decisions.reason: ADR-0003 fixes domain 7 and leaves local codes to the owner; PC_ prefix follows the GDD's frozen diagnostics names

decisions.chosen: Adapter-local InputContextMachine; context x action matrix is data, return table is code with one test per row; forced return to GAMEPLAY polled from loco_state; Adapter holds no ControlHandle and the Chart Table layer's PauseGate issues request_pause
decisions.reason: Contexts are presentation; the sim sees only the zero intent and cancel submitted on entry; pause rights are named handles (ADR-0002)

decisions.chosen: Only RenderLayout.mouse_to_world_aim(cursor_px, f_q) with its single picture-origin subtraction; aim_q = posmod(roundi(theta*AIM_UNITS/TAU), AIM_UNITS); mouse_to_world_view banned in the aim path (CTL-06)
decisions.reason: Open loop avoids the look-ahead feedback; exactly one letterbox subtraction exists; round-then-posmod per D.7

decisions.chosen: Accept that the Adapter (-100) reads the previous frame's f_q and layout with the last committed pos_curr, and on a zoom edge uses the stored cursor_off for one warp frame
decisions.reason: Coherent one-frame-old snapshot inside the GDD's recorded trade-off; warp read-back is a spike item

decisions.point: How the pipeline root 'receives' the cursor (TR-pc-032)
decisions.chosen: The root reads no Input; zoom edges arrive by request_zoom_step and the cursor is published as AdapterViews.cursor_px()
decisions.reason: Needs no new PipelineRoot interface and keeps the Input fence to the Adapter's files

decisions.point: Pulled views vs signals for Adapter outputs
decisions.chosen: AdapterViews is pulled with monotonic sequence counters (context, device, inspect_ref); the inspect_card_context_signal is realised as a pulled view
decisions.reason: A once-per-frame consumer cannot miss an edge; matches ADR-0009 and Interaction view patterns

decisions.chosen: Correlation-keyed PrePlayLedger ring; body and sound only, never effect or beam light; withdraw on immediate-reason rejection via Interaction's ReasonClass; Presenter and Audio read tokens through AdapterViews
decisions.reason: ADR-0009 section 7 assigns pre-play to this ADR; light and effects change only on committed state

decisions.chosen: Confirm and tap timers use the Adapter's _process delta clamped to CONFIRM_DT_MAX_S and freeze whenever the kernel is not RUNNING; the device-switch interval and name reveal read the injected monotonic Clock and are not frozen
decisions.reason: A destructive hold must not complete during a pause, but glyphs must follow a device switch while the Chart Table is open under PAUSED

decisions.point: Idle and other tick-stepped avatar frames vs the cosmetic-phase pattern
decisions.chosen: Idle breathing free-running from committed T; work, stagger and down anchored on sim-held entry ticks (channel start tick from Interaction, stagger_end_tick - STAGGER_TICKS, t_downed); recorded as a narrow exception to cosmetic_phase_from_tick_counter and filed as a foundation ask
decisions.reason: TR-pc-038/039 need byte-identical per-tick samples across cadences, which present_time cannot give; anchored loops keep weld animations starting at frame 0

decisions.chosen: Audio reads published odometer, gait, octant, facing; the Presenter's anim_counter is private; AvatarFrames.moving_frame is a shared pure function; FOOT_CONTACT_FRAMES comes from the sidecar
decisions.reason: Presentation-to-presentation edges are allowed and a private counter cannot be mistaken for a sim fact

decisions.chosen: 'Import fails' read as the asset-pipeline CI gate: numeric CHEST/HAND bounds as domain-2 named structural invariants of the sidecar table, lamp-plate occlusion as an AVATAR-* content-lint family; no runtime clamp in the Presenter (CTL-11)
decisions.reason: Avoids an editor-only importer plugin; one loader fails the game, tests and offline lint

decisions.chosen: tools/lint/config/allowlists/input_surface.json naming five Adapter files; controller_lint.gd rules CTL-01..09, 11, 12; CTL-10 unassigned (no-buffering is a behavioural test)
decisions.reason: ADR-0010 READ-01 leaves the list to ADR-0019; only five files hold engine input tokens

decisions.chosen: Integer-only per-frame text records (delta_us, analog milli-units, ordered edges, wheel net, cursor, pipeline values, kernel state/load_seq, focus/pad flags); cadence test uses at_tick events at multiples of 10 ticks; the simulation replays the recorded submission log, not a re-run Adapter
decisions.reason: All inputs are ints so the same build replays exactly; atan2 is not claimed bit-identical across machines; 10 is the LCM of the four frame periods in ticks

decisions.chosen: tool_cycle cycles from the Adapter's pending_tool over held slots 1-3 (one equip_tool per press); the console seam asks the Chart Table's pure resolver for SUBMIT/OPEN_CHART/NONE and injects ChartPick through a two-row table
decisions.reason: Two presses in one frame before commit must advance twice; CT-10 rows stay in the Chart Table, not the Adapter

decisions.chosen: controller.state rows are keyed by PlayerId and store no actor id; the Controller and Adapter resolve actor<->seat through Body's published seat_of_actor / actor_of_seat
decisions.reason: The seat is stored once (Body's seat) and the binding rebuild source stays Body's and Emitter's

cross_adr_assumptions.assumption: Body publishes body_of_actor(actor), actor_of_seat(player_id), seat_of_actor(actor), a pod-body test, home_body, moved(actor) and pos_curr/pos_prev/sub/odometer views; its transfer mutators (BM3 weld, BM4 detach, BM5 pod hop) reset pos_prev == pos_curr and sub in P2 so the Controller writes nothing in body.state; body.integrate is `after: [controller.step, layout.doors]` and reads the Controller's octant, gait_effective and intent_octant; PC-14 is adopted verbatim.

restore_after orders restore calls and every post_restore runs after every restore; controller.state declares restore_after [body.state, suit.state], and neither body.state nor suit.state declares restore_after on controller.state (no cycle); Suit's post_restore, if it derives locomotion_cap, runs before the Controller's; ADR-0016's carry_ref verifier checks that carry_ref resolves in Interaction's loose[] (controller.state holds only the bare id).

Interaction publishes a candidate query (caller-owned buffer of ref, distance, anchor, lit flag, declared verb and mode) that the Adapter scores per D.9 and a pulled focus/prompt view that echoes the Adapter's focus_ref and self_target; it declares the verb command type for the focused object, the pure ReasonClass.is_immediate(reason) table, cancel_channel and begin_* validates that read intent_octant; the channel record publishes its start tick for the work-loop animation anchor; validates reject for loco_state DEAD, DOWNED, IN_POD and STAGGERED per their rules; the three-part channel_view seqs (TR-hud-036) are Interaction's.

Suit publishes locomotion_cap(player_id), stowed_heavy(player_id), tool_in_hand(player_id) and the held tool slots 1-3; equip_tool {slot} is its command; the Controller reads only locomotion_cap and stowed_heavy.

The Chart Table layer consumes MenuInputQueue (drained once per frame after the Adapter), publishes cursor_hint through AdapterViews.set_cursor_hint, owns PauseGate and the opening of the layer on a chart_table context change, supplies ChartPickSource.resolve(prompt_verb), builds no Control that takes GUI navigation or keyboard focus (or supplies a text-entry probe), keeps its menu hold fills on engine time, owns SettingsStore for binding overrides and InputSettings, sets HUD nodes mouse_filter IGNORE / focus_mode NONE in gameplay, and keeps the Adapter PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS under any SceneTree.paused scheme.

Audio drives footfalls from Body's odometer and the Controller's gait_effective, octant and facing via the shared AvatarFrames.moving_frame, never from the Presenter's anim_counter; FOOT_CONTACT_FRAMES comes from the character sidecar; restore priming and the one-footfall catch-up poll are Audio's; Audio reads the Adapter's pre-play tokens through AdapterViews.

Attention publishes the push_stimulus Class B mutator that controller.noise calls once per moved tick (and the BURDEN push); Attention and Horror (ADR-0023) read only ControllerView.loco_state (lint CTL-05).
Emitter publishes the seat's beam id (actor for toggle_beam, actor_source emitter.state) and a beam view the Presenter reads (lit, shape); the beam light changes only on committed state.
Web Map owns the forbidden-action name list consumed by lint CTL-09 (HOP_LEG_TICKS is the sole pacing lever) and the pod body semantics behind IN_POD.
Dev feature tags gate dev_actions.gd, the PC_* diagnostics channels and the input-trace recorder so a release export file list contains none of them.

Co-op seats make the give_up solo test a kernel session fact instead of a controller.state row count; MIRROR runs no hook, so facing and channel_face arrive only as replicated state; remote ingress adds no second Adapter.

open_questions: TR-pc-035 as registered in tr-registry.yaml and requirements-traceability.md attributes Body's pos_prev == pos_curr and sub reset to controller.step; ADR-0019 reads it as Body's transfer mutators (ADR-0015) and the Controller clearing only the channel fields. Re-word the registered text at /architecture-review Phase 8; the GDD body never says it, so no GDD edit is proposed.

PC-INPUT-SPIKE-1 (a) to (i) must be run on a windowed 4.7.2 session and a release export: root mouse position units and fractional values under display scaling, warp_mouse read-back and synthetic motion under CONFINED_HIDDEN, wheel burst size per frame, real OS echo flag, which focus notification fires, pad ids / SDL3 merge / joy_connection_changed timing, -1 wildcard on real pads, Adapter-before-driver order on a release export (shared with KRN-LAT-02), and keyboard_get_label_from_physical on AZERTY/QWERTZ.
OQ-A: does the -1 any-device wildcard match every pad on a real SDL3 machine; fallback is per-device bindings rebuilt on joy_connection_changed behind BindingFactory.
OQ-B: does ADR-0030's Chart Table layer build any Control that takes keyboard focus (name entry, slot list)? If so set_input_as_handled in chart_table needs a TextEntryProbe port.
OQ-C: give_up solo detection is a controller.state row count; replace with a kernel session fact when co-op seats exist (ADR-0032).
OQ-D: shape of Interaction's candidate query and the focus/prompt echo view must be fixed in ADR-0020.
OQ-E: avatar sidecar table and lamp-plate mask formats do not exist (/asset-spec pending); ADR-0019 fixes where the checks run and what they report, not the file formats.
OQ-F: should a device switch to PAD also latch on a left-stick crossing the movement deadzone? The GDD says last button or key; ADR-0019 follows it.

The Controller Sim's Suit reads are locomotion_cap and stowed_heavy (TR-suit-033), but TR-pc-025 and AC-PCI-210 say locomotion_cap only; GDD sync proposed for AC-PCI-210, and the TR-pc-025 registered wording needs the same fix at Phase 8.
architecture.md's Required ADRs row for ADR-0019 says 21 requirements; the traceability index lists 42 in the Planned column plus residual halves; the index is authoritative.
TD ratification of PC-14 is the review of this ADR; until the ADR is Accepted the split is Proposed with the rest.
